name: 読書テーマの一覧
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. ONE existing Lighthouse component LH05-0019 読書テーマの一覧.
REFERENCE HIERARCHY: ORIGINAL Image1 controls theme-preview colors, tile anatomy, selection outline, proportions, opticalweight, alignment and fine details. Japanese mock Image2 supplies exact Japanese labels and locked type roles only; its mint replacements erase actual theme samples. Image3 style reference only; page stays purewhite.
Render exactly6rounded preview tiles in3columns by2rows,390x214logical. Tiles114x98,16pxcorners,10pxgaps,quietneutraloutlines and minimaldepth. Row1 labels“標準”,“静か”,“紙”. Row2 labels“太字”,“穏やか”,“集中”. Each has Japanese specimen“あ”above its label.
Typography LOCKED MeiryoREGULAR20/28 for specimen in all tiles EXCEPT“太字”tile specimen MeiryoBOLD20/28. ALL theme labels MeiryoREGULAR12/16,tracking0,notbold. Keep sample and label centered,sourceopticalspacing.
These are FUNCTIONAL THEME PREVIEWS, not tinted decorative UIcards: preserve meaningful ORIGINAL sample surfaces.
標準:white#FFFFFF,inktext,SELECTED with clear2pxforest#1F6444outline.
静か:charcoal#4A4B4Fpreview,lightgraylegibletext#D6D6D8.
紙:lightgray#EEEEEEpreview,inktext.
太字:whitepreview,inktext,boldspecimenonly.
穏やか:warmpaperbeige#EFE4C7preview,darkbrowntext.
集中:warmivory#FDFCF2preview,inktext.
Original blackselectionoutline adapted to officialforest. Do not change samples to mint,green,allwhite orforestgradient because that would falsify actualthemechoices. No broad tintedcanvas; outside6smallpreviewtiles stayspurewhite. No extra checkmarks or primaryCTA.
No heading,readerprose,sliders,toptools,customizebutton,sourcebranding,footerorwatermark. Exactly6tiles,6“あ”specimens,6Japanese labels;標準onlyselected. One isolated tightlyframed component.

Charcoal/gray/beige/ivoryactualtheme surfaces restored instead of mockmint. Outerwhitecanvas,quietborders,noinventedcontrols. Exactfontfamilymetricsandactualthemeapplicationunproven;agentvisualreviewonly.
